description: This Dart source file defines the TransactionModel class, representing a transaction entity in a finance tracking app. It includes fields for transaction details, methods for serialization/deserialization with a database, and utility functions for filtering and copying instances.

classes.name: TransactionModel
classes.description: A data model representing a financial transaction with properties for ID, category, amount, notes, and date information. Provides methods for creating instances from database maps, converting to database-compatible maps, copying with modifications, and filtering by date range.

methods.name: TransactionModel.fromMap
methods.description: Constructs a TransactionModel object from a map of database row data, parsing date strings into epoch milliseconds.

methods.name: TransactionModel.toMap
methods.description: Converts the TransactionModel instance into a map suitable for database storage, converting epoch milliseconds back into ISO 8601 strings.

methods.name: TransactionModel.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current transaction with optional modifications to specified fields.

methods.name: TransactionModel.onDate
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a transaction instance for a specific date.

methods.name: isWithinRange
methods.description: Checks whether the transaction's date falls within a specified start and end epoch millisecond range.
